text.en: Fran found fresh chalk marks on the platform pillar. Three hashes and a curve. Nobody claims them. They were not there at dawn count.
text.ru: Фрэн нашла на столбе платформы свежие меловые метки. Три черты и дуга — своими никто не зовёт. На утреннем пересчёте их ещё не было.

label.en: Leave them. Watch who looks twice

choices.effects_words: small hope gain; small discontent rise (unease)
small discontent drop; small hope loss

label.en: Copy the marks into the log

choices.effects_words: costs small influence; small hope gain

text.en: Leo's dig crew heard a handcar roll past the cut — no crest, no lamp. The rider did not answer the call. Tracks still warm.

label.en: Send two along the warm track

choices.effects_words: costs small food; small hope gain; optional dawn "Logged at the Listening Post" if Post staffed (no intel / no Probe)

label.en: Bar that spur for the night

choices.effects_words: small discontent rise; small hope held
small hope loss; small discontent rise

text.en: Ada pulled the air-filter cartridge and found green mold along the fold. The stack still draws, but the air tastes sweet in the wrong way.
text.ru: Ада вытащила кассету воздушного фильтра и нашла зелёную плесень по сгибу. Фильтр ещё тянет, но воздух сладковат — не так, как надо.

choices.effects_words: costs small materials; air held; small hope gain

label.en: Scrape it and run another week

choices.effects_words: small air loss risk; small discontent rise

label.en: Boil the mesh by the generator

choices.effects_words: small power loss this week; air held

text.en: Vic says two on night watch have been selling their sleep shifts for tokens. The posts stay filled on paper. The eyes on them do not.

label.en: Ban the trade. Name them on the platform

choices.effects_words: small discontent rise; small hope held
